attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"Elias stood before the caravan ruins, the snow swirling around the broken sleds where Constance had perished","reason":"Briefing never puts Elias at the site of the lost caravan or mentions sleds."},{"span":"even when the blizzard threatened to bury them all","reason":"Implies Elias was caught in the blizzard; the briefing does not say he was."}],"voice":3,"clarity":2,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The setting is muddled: it starts in the silence of Wren's Hollow, moves to the caravan ruins and then to a village gate, and it invents Elias being at the death site.
